items.briefing:
A malware campaign linked to fake job lures originating from Cambodia is actively deploying SparkRAT, a remote access tool that gives attackers control of infected devices. Australian staff should be cautious of unsolicited job offers or attachments from unknown sources, particularly via email or messaging apps.

On a broader note, industry reports suggest Australian organisations are slow to adopt AI securely, which may increase exposure to emerging threats. Several security vendors are releasing new AI-focused identity and software protection tools this week. **Practical tip:** Be sceptical of unexpected job offers online — avoid clicking links or downloading attachments before verifying the sender's legitimacy.

featured.title: Okta & Deloitte join forces on AI identity controls
